name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-metacritic
description: Search Metacritic films, shows and games, read scores and critic reviews. No API key.

environmentVariables.name: MC_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Override the User-Agent sent to Metacritic.

environmentVariables.name: MC_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 1000, floor 500.

environmentVariables.name: MC_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error.
